title: Claim ready work for orchestrated workers
description:
As an operator, I want Kanbus to claim exactly one ready issue for a worker, so that multiple workers cannot execute the same task.

Feature: Orchestrated issue claiming
Scenario: Claim the next ready issue
Given multiple open issues and one worker id
When the operator runs claim-next with ready filtering
Then exactly one unblocked open issue is moved to in_progress and assigned to that worker.
